groups.note: Supreme Court justices and the Chancery Court judge are in the shared statewide judicial file. Local names are 4th Judicial District judges retained by name on official Sheridan County general ballots, plus the circuit judge named on the official June 12, 2026 clerk roster. Sheryl Smith Bunting did not appear on the official 2026 general summary. The official 2018 circuit-judge retention has no name on the summary.
